content: Summing many WebAudio sources straight into destination clips once combined amplitude exceeds 1.0. Standard fix: master GainNode with headroom + DynamicsCompressorNode before destination (MDN DynamicsCompressorNode: 'especially important in games where large numbers of sounds play simultaneously... helps avoid clipping'). Ducking = lower ambient-bus gain (setTargetAtTime) when combat SFX fire; requires separate ambient vs sfx buses. Never ramp exponentialRampToValueAtTime to exactly 0 (throws).
